title: On this day in space! Nov. 19, 2005: Japan's Hayabusa spacecraft makes 1st-ever liftoff from surface of an asteroid
caption:
When Japan's Hayabusa spacecraft touched down on asteroid Itokawa, its sampling mechanism failed completely. Yet when the return capsule landed in Australia years later, scientists discovered 1,500 microscopic grains forced inside by impact alone.

Source: Space - On this day in space! Nov. 19, 2005: Japan's Hayabusa spacecraft makes 1st-ever liftoff from surface of an asteroid
